textRuns.value: The slicer rail on the left of each page (Date, Service, Risk level, Actor type, User, Status) is synced, so a selection follows you between pages. Risk level is an attribute of the action, looked up in the ActionRiskMap table: High = destructive or privilege-changing actions (Delete, Purge, Deactivate, Revoke, Reset ...), Medium = configuration changes and data access (Create, Update, Assign, Download, Export ...), Low = read-only and session actions (View, Login, Logout ...). Actions not in the map are rated Medium and listed on the Data Health page so they can be added. Actor type is User for interactive actions, OAuth Client for integrations and scripts, System for platform actions. Data freshness is Fresh within 30 hours of the last event, Late within 54 hours, otherwise Stale.
Source files: genesys-audit_YYYY-MM-DD.json, one per UTC day, read from the configured SharePoint folder.
